music_drills_circle_setup_analysis_note: Each chord of the tune, each section once: pick its key centre, then its function there. The analysis follows three rules. A chord reached from its own V7, tritone sub or backdoor is a new key's I. A ii-V belongs to the key it resolves to. A dominant that resolves to anything else is a V of. After a miss, you see the rule that applies.

music_drills_studio_out_of_range_ukulele: As written: some notes are out of the ukulele's range.
music_drills_studio_pads_label: MPC pads, bank A, the kit's drums. Computer keys Z X C V play the bottom row.
music_drills_studio_playing_on: Playing on {instrument}. MIDI, the on-screen keys and your computer keyboard all work.
music_drills_studio_playing_on_mic: Playing on {instrument}, and octaves don't count against you through the microphone. MIDI, the on-screen keys and your computer keyboard all work.
music_drills_studio_range_drums: The drum grid can't mark a range yet. Pick Sections instead.
music_drills_studio_range_switch: Switch to Staff or Tab to mark the range.
music_drills_studio_range_tap: Tap where the range starts on the notation below, then where it ends. Drag the Start and End handles to adjust.
music_drills_studio_sight_counts: Your first run of this song: it counts as a sight-read.
music_drills_studio_sight_not_counted: Not your first run of this song, so it doesn't count as a sight-read.
music_drills_studio_spot_clean_full: Clean at full tempo. The loop widens to {where}.
music_drills_studio_spot_clean_row: {count} clean in a row. Back to full tempo, {bpm} BPM.
music_drills_studio_spot_fixed: Fixed: {where} clean {count} times running at {bpm} BPM.
music_drills_studio_spot_next: {line} The next try starts in a moment.
music_drills_studio_spot_not_clean: Not clean yet: {where} again at {bpm} BPM.
music_drills_studio_staff_failed: The staff can't draw this song. {link}, which shows every note.
music_drills_studio_stopped_for: Stopped for {beats} beats at {where}. After a slip, come back in on the next beat.
music_drills_studio_tap_hint: Tap the rhythm: any key, pad or MIDI note, or Space.
music_drills_studio_unmeasured_level: the input carries no breath or velocity (MIDI or the Aerophone measure it)
music_drills_studio_unseen: The notes stay hidden until you start: then {seconds} seconds to look, and one pass in time.
music_drills_studio_vib_row: Vibrato on held notes, 4 to 5 a second
music_drills_studio_vib_unmeasured: Vibrato on held notes (no bite arrived as pitch bend)

match.wrongPlural=one: {clean} of {total} right first time, {wrong} wrong note.
match.wrongPlural=other: {clean} of {total} right first time, {wrong} wrong notes.

music_drills_studio_wait_status: Wait mode: play {range} at your own pace. Woodshed waits for each note.
music_drills_voicings_arp_aerophone: Arpeggio mode: the Aerophone plays one note at a time, so each voicing is scored as an arpeggio. Play the root first, then the other tones in any order.
music_drills_voicings_arp_voice: Arpeggio mode: your voice plays one note at a time, so each voicing is scored as an arpeggio. Play the root first, then the other tones in any order.
music_drills_voicings_blurb: Jazz voicings, closest inversions and cadences through the keys. Untimed: take the time to find each chord.
music_drills_voicings_check_hidden: Check: the voicing and the hints are hidden.
music_drills_voicings_check_play: Play {symbol}, root in the left hand.
music_drills_voicings_collected: Notes collected: {notes}. On-screen keys play one at a time, so held together isn't measured.
music_drills_voicings_demo: Demo playing, not scored: {chords}, lit as each chord sounds.
music_drills_voicings_hidden_check: The voicing is hidden: keys light only where you play.
music_drills_voicings_keys_show: Keys show L for the left-hand root and R for the right hand. No fingering is given for voicings: use what feels comfortable.
music_drills_voicings_keys_show_jazz: Keys show L for the left hand and R for the right hand. No fingering is given for voicings: use what feels comfortable.
music_drills_voicings_piano_label: Piano keyboard, {low} to {high}. Left hand root marked L, right hand notes R.
music_drills_voicings_row_scoring_text: each chord scored while you held all its notes together
music_drills_voicings_setup_note: Over MIDI each chord is scored as you hold it, with no extra notes. On-screen keys collect the notes one at a time. A one-note instrument plays each voicing as an arpeggio.
music_drills_voicings_stopped: Stopped. The chords you finished are saved. The rest aren't.
music_drills_voicings_v_cadence: Cadences I IV I V7 I
music_drills_voicings_v_cadence_minor: Minor cadences i iv i V7 i
music_drills_voicings_v_inversions: Closest chords, I IV V I
